title: MANDATE — character & life: make it engaging enough to finish a term

stories.title: Merge PRs #130/#131/#132 into main
acceptanceCriteria: PRs #130, #131, #132 are merged/closed and main contains the living-institution work
npm run check is green on main after merge

stories.title: Homepage chart shows all four economic series, readably
acceptanceCriteria: ChartsPanel renders inflation, unemployment, policy_rate, AND credibility as distinct visible series (credibility on its own scale so the rate series are not flattened)
A web test asserts all four series are present in the chart data and credibility uses a separate axis/panel
Verified in-browser: all four lines are visible after advancing several months

stories.title: Committee member names are generated per-seed (vary every game)
acceptanceCriteria: MeetingPanel + PersuasionView display committee member names via session.npcName(member.id), not the static localization name keys
Two sessions with different seeds show different committee member names
A web/node test asserts committee display names differ across seeds

stories.title: Candidate slates refresh (after firing and over time)
acceptanceCriteria: generateCandidates varies by a refresh dimension so a division's slate is not frozen forever
After firing a director and a refresh, candidatesFor returns a different slate than before
A node test asserts a refreshed slate differs from the prior one; determinism preserved for a fixed refresh index

stories.title: Events have visible, felt consequences + an activity feed
acceptanceCriteria: Resolving an escalation records what changed (which vars moved and by how much) into a session activity log
An activity-feed UI shows recent events and their effects on The Desk
A test asserts resolving an escalation adds a feed entry describing the effect

stories.title: Continuous real-time-with-pause time controls
acceptanceCriteria: A clock control offers Pause + Play with speed settings (slow/normal/fast) that advance time continuously via a timer
Time advances at weekly granularity (sub-monthly cadence) so it feels continuous, not turn-based
Pausing stops advancement; a meeting month pauses automatically for the decision
A web test asserts play advances the date over time and pause halts it

stories.title: Briefings specify the analyzed target rate + projection horizon
acceptanceCriteria: Each briefing scenario branch states the analyzed target policy rate and labels the projection horizon (e.g. one-year-ahead outlook)
Content + localization updated; npm run validate green
The persuasion/briefing UI shows the target rate and horizon label

stories.title: Frontend-design polish — distinctive character, not generic
acceptanceCriteria: Apply the frontend-design skill to give the shell genuine visual character (typography, depth, motion/feedback, an editorial Fed aesthetic)
The full web suite stays green and the build succeeds
Verified in-browser: the UI reads as a crafted product, not a default inspector
